_what_this_is: An external, committed, content-addressed provenance record for every capture directory in this tree. Look a capture up by the sha256 of its own bytes: python3 provenance.py whence <file>.
_scope_rule: every directory under this tree holding at least one *-raw.json, plus every directory carrying a CAPTURED-FROM-TENANT stamp

_evidence_tiers.A: written INTO the directory by the capture run itself (stamp, preconditions transcript, attestation sidecar). Only tier A fills the `tenant` field.
_evidence_tiers.B: a committed capture script naming the directory. Says what the recipe targets, not what a run read.
_evidence_tiers.C: a filename or directory-name label. Not evidence: see t22-probe/PROVENANCE-NOTE.md for a label in this tree that meant something else.

directories.note: The ORIGINAL Path B corpus (B-01..B-04 plus two product read-backs). No tier-A record exists inside it. Two committed files say what tenant it was taken on, and both are tier-B prose rather than a run-written record: REPRODUCE.md:62-63 marks the recipe as 'CHANGED by T36 (T22 P0-6): captures are taken on the production-settings tenant, never `default`', and t22-audit/modeprobe2.sh:4 describes tenant `default` as 'what Path B was captured at'. On that basis this set is believed to be a `default`-tenant capture, which is why T36 re-captured on `gerege` at all — but believed is not established, so `tenant` stays null here rather than being filled in from prose.

directories.note: THE DIRECTORY THIS INDEX WAS WRITTEN FOR (T85's fourth finding, closed by T99). It has no CAPTURED-FROM-TENANT stamp because it PREDATES the mechanism: these files were first committed in fab040a (2026-08-18) and the stamp was introduced in 813acb1 (2026-08-20) - both checkable with `git log`. Its tenant is nevertheless established in-band by two artefacts the capture run itself wrote into the directory: preconditions.txt line 1 ("== T36 Path B preconditions, tenant 'gerege' ==", followed by P13's JVM 'Initialized rounding mode for tenant `gerege`: HALF_UP' line and P14's behavioural half-cent canary) and attestation.json's tenant.identifier. T99 declined to re-capture it: a stamp written today would attest to today's run, not to this one, and would replace the very bytes six other sets are proved byte-identical to. See this file's header.
